# Vendored source manifest

Source: Sapiens dentistry working tree supplied for this project.
Files below were copied as source only. No data, annotations, checkpoints, outputs or binaries are included.
Original upstream license: `LICENSE` in this directory (CC BY-NC 4.0).

Local adaptations: portable configuration, removal of an inactive patient-specific heatmap debug block, CLI test paths made explicit.
The existing zero-loss baseline fix and image-only black-border transform are retained.
